unmapped_fields.reason: Customer Name is documented only as the business or individual name; no source definition establishes it as the registered legal name required for entity.legal_name, and it is not mapped to any other canonical field.
Registration Date is an object registration date; no source definition establishes it as the entity date_registered or a whole-observation validity date, so it is not mapped.
RSO Number is the suitable operator register reference number; the ontology has no canonical register reference field, so no supported output exists.
Registration Status describes the register registration state rather than the business entity status; no explicit equivalence to the canonical status enum is documented, so it is not mapped.
